class_names: Class filters use DTA class names, not C++ names -- see probes/dta_classes.json. RndDrawable enumerates ZERO where Draw enumerates 45.
note: Generated by tools/state_diff; see docs/tools/STATE_DIFF.md. Request counts are measured against the 'portable' transport profile (script < 16384, reply <= 32768) for 60 objects in the spec's default dir. Scoping the capture elsewhere (--dir panel:<panel>) changes the object count and charges the dir expression's length against the same script cap.

cameras.discriminates: whole-screen framing wrong (FOV/aspect), geometry clipped by near/far planes, viewport/target-rect covering the wrong screen region, camera positioned or aimed wrongly, letterboxing differences
cameras.doc: RndCam near/far planes, vertical FOV, depth range, viewport rect and world placement.
cameras.enumeration: target roster; portable DTA object_list (sorted, cursor-paged), iterate/iterate_self fallback; native /api/objects fast path for dir=main only

draw_state.discriminates: invisible or wrongly-visible objects; draw-order / z-fighting and overlay-stacking bugs; frustum culling caused by a zero or stale bounding sphere
